title: Office Scripts Workflow
prompt:
Create a script that formats a table and generates a summary.

Skills: Office Scripts and workbook APIs.

Use the supplied synthetic CSV at assets/data/practical-23-office-scripts-workflow.csv. A small copy/pastable sample is included below in case the CSV is not directly downloadable from the lesson page. Complete the work in a separate .xlsx copy, preserve a raw-data sheet, and check the result against the acceptance criteria. Then answer the short grading check; it does not validate the workbook itself.

Sample CSV (synthetic):
Region,Amount
East,250
West,180
East,90
North,320
objective: Create a script that formats a table and generates a summary.

starter.instructions: Open/import the UTF-8 CSV into Excel. Keep the original source data unchanged and perform work on a separate sheet or workbook.

expected_output: Expected: script checks required objects and data before writing, and is tested in a supported tenant/environment.

public_tests.name: Sample-data acceptance
checklist: Input records are preserved and data types are checked.
Totals/results reconcile with a small independent calculation.
An edge case, duplicate or threshold boundary is tested where relevant.

public_tests.name: Server-side answer check
public_tests.note: A text/choice check does not execute Excel or inspect the workbook artifact.

acceptance_criteria: Expected: script checks required objects and data before writing, and is tested in a supported tenant/environment.
Use a labeled result area and document formulas, assumptions or transformation steps.
Compare actual results with a manual/independently calculated expected result and test one edge case.
Keep source data intact and request human review of the completed workbook; do not treat the text grader as artifact validation.
hints: Import data without losing dates, decimals or leading zeros.
Separate raw inputs, calculations and presentation outputs.
Test empty inputs, duplicated keys, boundary values or missing matches as appropriate to the scenario.

grading_config.expected_text: function main(workbook: ExcelScript.Workbook) { const sheet = workbook.getActiveWorksheet(); sheet.getRange("A1").setValue("Report ready"); }

grading_method: Server-side exact_text check of the submitted answer/expression only; does not execute Excel or inspect the workbook. This workbook-practice task needs a human-reviewed artifact and test evidence for full acceptance. A simple Office Script sets A1; adapt to the supported environment and validate the target range before modifying the workbook.
retry_policy: Retries are permitted. A failed string/choice submission does not complete the exercise. Course files do not define XP; platform-wide server logic applies.
